scope: GC36: one direct child field on an ordinary stdClass WeakMap Key, before or after first registration, with ordered Map value, weak observer and child cleanup.
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; tests/semantics/profile.json; LC_ALL=C; TZ=UTC
rule_basis: Zend/zend_objects.c::zend_object_std_dtor calls zend_weakrefs_notify before dynamic property destruction. Zend/zend_weakrefs.c::zend_weakref_unref visits registrations in order and removes Map entries or clears the wrapper; entry value destruction may execute PHP. Modules386/359 retain the original one-slot Key image and its child owner under the physical storage pin; NOTIFY must clear before instance-storage-slot transfers the child owner.

validation.author: Two normal source/native exact pairs; two source-reached checks of 51 conditions each, including real pin, sole child owner, observer transition, malformed slot/allocation controls, and 0-step budget resumption.
validation.independent: Three normal source/native exact pairs for preinsert, postinsert and observer-first, one normal caught-throw suffix, plus 36 Value-callback and 34 Child-callback reached conditions. Initial fixture failures retain zero credit.
validation.affected: Prior GC32 selective standard-Key source agrees and its unchanged source-reached suite passes 71 conditions.
validation.unsupported: One two-field original stops explicitly at first insertion after B|; native behavior is retained separately and earns zero agreement. Initial author count-call/nondeterminism candidates also earn zero credit.

limits: Admitted Key is stdClass with exactly one direct dynamic property owning a sole childless instance whose only method is a public no-argument destructor; one Map entry. Other fields, table-backed layouts, multiple Maps, freeing-object mutation, active-pin collection and wider callbacks retain Unsupported boundaries. No collector/count/nogc rule changed.
